nodes.speaker: Mr Wilco
nodes.text: Morning. Bit of a wait, I'm afraid.

nodes.speaker: Mr Wilco
nodes.text: Always, before an audit. You learn to smile through it.

nodes.speaker: Mr Wilco
nodes.text: Insurance. Don't ask. I didn't, and I still got the invoice.

nodes.speaker: Mr Wilco
nodes.text: Do I? I'm told I have that face. Enjoy your morning.

nodes.speaker: Mr Wilco
nodes.text: Stay calm. They'll take what they want and go. They always do.

nodes.speaker: Mr Wilco
nodes.text: Keep your head down. It'll be over soon.

nodes.speaker: Mr Wilco
nodes.text: Vander. Take that to the usual place. Don't count it in the car.

nodes.speaker: Mr Wilco
nodes.text: And you. Go on ahead. Straight down the alley, don't look back, don't run.
Eleven months. Eleven months of planning, and you were going to be the reason.
